newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: ANZ cuts key mortgage rate to 6.99 pct.
newsitem.headline: ANZ cuts key mortgage rate to 6.99 pct.

text.p: The Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd (ANZ) said on Tuesday it had cut its variable Australian mortgage interest rate again to 6.99 percent from 7.20 percent, after having cut it from 7.55 percent on Friday after an official rate cut.
The cut would apply from Wednesday for new customers and from July 21 for existing customers.
ANZ said the latest cut represented a total reduction of 0.56 percent after the 0.50 percent cut in official rates on Friday by the Reserve Bank of Australia.
"ANZ is determed to offer the most competitive home loan rate in today's market," ANZ Chief General Manager of Australian Retail Peter Hawkins said in a statement.
ANZ said it would also cut the interest rate on its Money Saver Home Loan, its no-frills product, to 6.6 percent from 6.9 percent.

ANZ's latest mortgage rate cut comes after heavy political pressure and an investigation by the Australian Competition and Consumer Commission into the four major banks' initial decision to all pass on only 0.35 percent of the 0.5 percent cut.
The other three major banks, National Australia Bank Ltd, Westpac Banking Corp and Commonwealth Bank of Australia, have yet to follow ANZ's lead.
